projects.name: Dublin data center land parcel
projects.quote: During the second quarter, Digital Realty acquired an 8-acre parcel in Dublin for $6 million, which can support up to 40 megawatts of IT load.

projects.name: Barcelona data center land parcel
projects.quote: Digital Realty also acquired 2.4 acres in Barcelona for $11 million, which can support up to 15 megawatts of IT load.

projects.name: Frankfurt data center land parcel
projects.quote: Lastly, Digital Realty acquired 34 acres in Frankfurt for $60 million, which can support up to 70 megawatts of IT load.

projects.name: Digital Realty Mivne Petah Tikvah data center campus
projects.quote: Digital Realty Mivne expects to develop a multi-tenant data center campus in Petah Tikvah, the primary connectivity hub in Israel.

projects.name: Paris data center land parcel
projects.quote: Subsequent to the close of the second quarter, Digital Realty acquired 38 acres in Paris for $11 million and 9 acres in Stockholm for $43 million.
